That duplicate handling is right. I pasted the same recipe address but with all that "utm_source" and "utm_campaign" tracking junk tacked on the end, and it still recognized it as the one I already had — it jumped me to the existing roast-potato bookmark, kept the count at eight, and left the clean address I'd saved intact instead of replacing it with the messy one. The little note even said the tracking text was ignored.

That's exactly what I'd want, honestly better than I'd have thought to ask for. When I copy a link out of a newsletter it's always got that gibberish on the end, and I don't want that to trick the app into thinking it's a brand-new page and giving me a duplicate. Good call.

I'm happy with that. What's next?
